第13章 他不屑她的感情1（第1页）
回到家，已经接近傍晚，夏晚安亲自下厨做了三菜一汤。她其实吃不了这么多的，但她若是有时间煮饭，她总是会煮两人份。是啊，没错，两人份的饭，其中一份就是给他做的，即便她知道，他不会回家吃饭，也不会和她一同吃饭，可她每次都还是会固执的去做。因为只有在家里，只有她一个人的时候，她才敢做一些和他能扯上关系的事。准备好饭菜后，夏晚安会在桌子上摆放两幅碗筷，会把对面的那个碗里盛满了汤，还会在动筷子之前说一句：“吃饭吧……”回应她的是一如既往的安静。这次的她，没像往常那样，立刻动筷子，而是盯着对面空荡荡的桌椅看了会儿，就仿佛他真的坐在对面一般，很小声很小声的念了句：“经年……”天知道，这两个字，她一个人偷偷的在心底喊过多少遍。她想，他永远也看不见她爱他的时候，因为她只有在看不见他的时候，才敢爱他……夏晚安话音落定后，没敢多看对面一眼，就低头开始喝汤。喝着喝着，她喉咙里突然有些堵，然后她才后知后觉的发现，自己的眼角好像湿了。明明很喜欢他，可她却总是要装出一副无关痛痒的模样来告诉全世界的人他和她没关系。她不是不想告诉他她喜欢他，可比起来得不到他的爱，她更怕彻底的失去了他这个人。她曾亲眼目睹过他是如何拒绝了一个女人对他的表白，他是那么绝情那么寡义，根本没给对方留丝毫缓转的余地，所以她一直小心翼翼的把自己的感情锁在心底，维持着根本不在意他的形象，因为她知道，他不屑她的感情，他要的只是婚姻，不是纠缠，尽管她不知道也很好奇他为什么会要这样一个毫无意义的婚姻………周一，夏晚安照常上班。她是在嫁给韩经年一年后，才进了韩氏企业工作，她之所以能进韩氏企业，和韩经年没太大的关系，纯粹是他大嫂，也就是韩知谨母亲陆燕归的意思。韩经年有两个哥哥，大哥韩经文比他大了将近三十岁，二哥韩经纶比他大了十八岁，在韩经年还没出生之前，他的大哥韩经文就已经成家了，在韩经年三岁那一年，大哥出了意外，留下了怀着孕的大嫂，撒手人寰，他身体本就不怎么好的母亲由于过于伤心，第二年就跟着病逝了，好在韩经年的祖母比较长寿，接替他的母亲，将他抚养长大。不过说来也蛮奇怪的，韩家很多男儿，但都不怎么长命，韩经年的父亲六十多岁就猝死了，二哥韩经纶更是英年早逝，刚过了三十岁生日，就跟着身亡了。韩经年三个兄弟，一下子只剩了他一人，当时的他十二岁，韩知谨九岁，所以韩氏企业的重任一下子就压在了祖母和大嫂陆燕归的身上，不过在三年前，韩经年从国外回来，进入韩氏企业后，祖母只挂了个ceo的职位，基本上已经不管事了。：最后这一段是背景，背景，背景！看不懂的请多看几遍，很容易理解的，如果实在理解不了，我也没办法！另外这是一个正常的小说，请不要封建迷信，没有被诅咒不长命这一说哈！不得不说~还挺佩服你们的脑洞！！

Chapter 13 He disdains her feelings 1 (Page 1)
When I got home, it was almost evening. Xia Wanan personally cooked three dishes and one soup. She actually couldn't eat so much, but if she had time to cook, she would always cook for two. Yes, that's right, one of the meals for two was cooked for him. Even though she knew that he would not go home to eat or eat with her, she would still stubbornly do it every time. Because only when she was alone at home, she dared to do something that had anything to do with him. After preparing the meal, Xia Wan'an would place two sets of bowls and chopsticks on the table, fill the opposite bowl with soup, and say before moving the chopsticks: "Let's eat..." The response to her was as quiet as ever. This time, she did not move her chopsticks immediately like usual, but stared at the empty table and chairs opposite for a while, as if he was really sitting across from him, and whispered: "Jiang Nian..." God knows, she secretly shouted these two words in her heart so many times. She thought that he would never see her love him, because she only dared to love him when she couldn't see him... After Xia Wan'an finished speaking, he lowered his head and started to drink the soup without daring to look at the other person. While drinking, there was a sudden lump in her throat, and then she realized belatedly that the corners of her eyes seemed to be wet. She obviously likes him very much, but she always has to pretend to be indifferent to tell the world that he has nothing to do with her. It's not that she doesn't want to tell him that she likes him, but she is more afraid of losing him completely than not getting his love. She had witnessed with her own eyes how he rejected a woman's confession to him. He was so heartless and unjust, leaving no room for the other party to change. So she had been carefully keeping her feelings locked in her heart, maintaining the image of not caring about him at all, because she knew that he disdained her feelings. What he wanted was marriage, not entanglement. Although she didn't know and was curious about why he wanted such a meaningless marriage... On Monday, Xia Wan'an went to work as usual. She only joined Han's Enterprise one year after marrying Han Jingnian. The reason why she was able to join Han's Enterprise had nothing to do with Han Jingnian. It was purely because of the wishes of his sister-in-law, Han Zhijin's mother Lu Yangui. Han Jingnian has two brothers. The eldest brother Han Wenwen is nearly thirty years older than him, and the second brother Han Jinglun is eighteen years older than him. Before Han Jingnian was born, his eldest brother Han Wenwen had already married. When Han Jingnian was three years old, the eldest brother was born. He died in an accident, leaving his pregnant sister-in-law behind. His mother, who was not in good health, was too sad and died of illness the next year. Fortunately, Han Jingnian's grandmother lived a long life and succeeded his mother and raised him. But it is strange to say that many men in the Han family did not live long. Han Jingnian's father died suddenly when he was in his sixties, and his second brother Han Jinglun died young, just after his thirtieth birthday. Han Jingnian was the only one left among the three brothers. He was twelve years old at the time and Han Zhijin was nine years old. Therefore, the heavy responsibility of Han's enterprise suddenly fell on his grandmother and sister-in-law Lu Yangui. However, three years ago, Han Jingnian came back from abroad and after entering Han's enterprise, his grandmother only held the position of CEO and basically stopped doing anything. : This last paragraph is background, background, background! If you don’t understand, please read it a few times. It’s easy to understand. If you really can’t understand it, there’s nothing I can do about it! In addition, this is a normal novel, please don’t be superstitious and don’t say you are cursed and will not live long! Have to say~I really admire your imagination! !
